answer: Because you financed through Bayline Credit Union, we sent the title paperwork to Bayline, and they hold the title until the loan is paid off; Northwind no longer has it. You'll generally need a payoff letter stating your account number, payoff amount, good-through date, and where to send payment, ideally a 15-day payoff amount. You can get it from Bayline yourself, or sign form NW-LPA-1 and we'll request it for you (allow 2 business days). If Bayline is in our e-payoff network you won't need a letter at all, but the help center doesn't say which lenders are in that network, so please check with a store.
